entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need some help with an order I received about a month ago. It's for a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it. I see the order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered on December 5th, which was 41 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but this jersey is just the wrong size for me. It's way too tight across the chest. I'd like to see about processing an exchange.
I understand completely, getting the right fit is crucial. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up the policy for that specific item.

Okay, I have good news. That jersey is a standard apparel item, which falls under our 90-day return and exchange policy. Since it's only been 41 days, you are well within the window. I can set up that exchange for you right now.
That's great to hear. Now, since I do have to package this up and send it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 15% off for the trouble?

I appreciate you asking. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on sizing exchanges, I can confirm the entire process is free of charge. We'll provide a prepaid shipping label for the return, and there's no cost to ship the new size out to you.
I see. Okay, how about this: instead of an exchange, you process a full return, and I'll buy the new one. Could you waive the expedited shipping fee on that new order?

That's a clever thought, but the system is set up so the direct exchange is actually the quickest and most straightforward path. It triggers the new shipment automatically once your return is scanned by the carrier. We can definitely get the exchange for the correct size started for you right away, if you'd like?
Alright, you've made your case. The free exchange sounds like the best path forward then. Let's go ahead with that.
Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for the same jersey, one size up. You should receive an email with a printable, prepaid return label within the next 15 minutes. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
